usage: agentbreeder services down [-h] [--volumes] [--purge] [--yes] [--json]
                                  [dir]

positional arguments:
  dir

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --volumes   Also delete the stack's volumes
  --purge     Delete everything `up` made: volumes, built service images,
              generated secrets, operator config and history (the next `up`
              starts from scratch)
  --yes
  --json
